annotations.title: List the On the Cheap sites

description: List every city in the "on the Cheap" network with the `site` key used to select it. This server reads them all — every other tool takes a `site` argument, and there is no default, so start here when you do not already know which key covers the city the user means. Read-only.
name: otc_list_sites
title: List the On the Cheap sites
